rows.gloss: 待洗或洗好的衣物；洗衣这件事

answer.meaning_zh: 待洗或洗好的衣物；洗衣这件事
answer.example_en: I have a lot of laundry to do today.
answer.example_zh: 我今天有很多衣服要洗。
answer.usage_note: laundry可指洗衣活动或待洗、洗好的衣物，通常不可数。

answer.example_en: I wash my gym clothes after every workout.
answer.example_zh: 每次锻炼后我都会洗运动服。
answer.usage_note: wash在此指洗涤衣物。

answer.example_en: This laundry load is too large for the machine.
answer.example_zh: 这一批衣服太多，洗衣机装不下。
answer.usage_note: laundry load指一次洗涤的衣物量。

answer.example_en: Put your dirty towels in the laundry basket.
answer.example_zh: 把脏毛巾放进洗衣篮。
answer.usage_note: laundry basket既可用于暂存也可搬运衣物。

answer.example_en: I keep dirty socks in the laundry hamper.
answer.example_zh: 我把脏袜子放在脏衣篓里。
answer.usage_note: hamper在北美家庭语境常指脏衣篓。

answer.example_en: The washing machine is on a gentle cycle.
answer.example_zh: 洗衣机正在运行轻柔洗涤程序。
answer.usage_note: washing machine是洗衣机，与dryer烘干机不同。

answer.example_en: I took the towels out of the dryer.
answer.example_zh: 我从烘干机里取出了毛巾。
answer.usage_note: dryer表示衣物烘干机，应核查衣物能否烘干。

answer.example_en: The laundry room is downstairs.
answer.example_zh: 洗衣房在楼下。
answer.usage_note: laundry room是洗衣和烘干的专用空间。

answer.example_en: Measure the detergent before adding it to the washer.
answer.example_zh: 加入洗衣机前先量好洗涤剂。
answer.usage_note: detergent在此是衣物洗涤剂。

answer.example_en: I skip fabric softener when washing sports towels.
answer.example_zh: 洗运动毛巾时我不用柔顺剂。
answer.usage_note: fabric softener用于柔顺织物，不替代洗衣剂。

answer.example_en: I applied stain remover before washing the shirt.
answer.example_zh: 洗衬衫前我先用了去渍剂。
answer.usage_note: stain remover用于预处理污渍，须确认适用面料。

answer.example_en: Store detergent pods away from young children.
answer.example_zh: 把洗衣凝珠存放在幼童接触不到的地方。
answer.usage_note: detergent pod是预分装洗涤剂凝珠，应保持原包装并安全锁存。

answer.example_en: The care label says to wash the sweater in cold water.
answer.example_zh: 洗护标签写着毛衣要用冷水洗。
answer.usage_note: care label说明洗涤、干燥和熨烫等条件。

answer.example_en: I selected the spin cycle to remove extra water.
answer.example_zh: 我选择脱水程序去除多余水分。
answer.usage_note: spin cycle主要通过高速旋转脱水，非漂洗。

answer.example_en: There's a coffee stain on the sleeve.
answer.example_zh: 袖子上有一块咖啡渍。
answer.usage_note: stain是污渍，通常可数。

answer.example_en: Sort the laundry by color before starting the washer.
answer.example_zh: 开洗衣机前先按颜色分类。
answer.usage_note: sort指分拣衣物，为清洗做准备。

answer.example_en: I fold the laundry while listening to music.
answer.example_zh: 我一边听音乐一边叠洗好的衣服。
answer.usage_note: fold the laundry指将洗好晾干的衣物叠整齐。

answer.example_en: This silk blouse is delicate, so handle it gently.
answer.example_zh: 这件真丝衬衫很娇贵，要轻拿轻放。
answer.usage_note: delicate表示易受损，洗护应温和。

answer.example_en: An extra rinse removed the detergent residue.
answer.example_zh: 额外漂洗一次去掉了洗涤剂残留。
answer.usage_note: detergent residue指洗涤后留在衣物上的洗衣剂。

answer.example_en: I hang clothes to dry on sunny days.
answer.example_zh: 天气晴朗时我把衣服挂起来晾干。
answer.usage_note: 该表达是来源中的场景补缺候选，尚待独立审核。

rows.gloss: 洗衣液；洗衣粉等洗涤剂

answer.meaning_zh: 洗衣液；洗衣粉等洗涤剂
answer.example_en: Choose a laundry detergent suitable for the fabric.
answer.example_zh: 选择适合面料的洗衣剂。
answer.usage_note: laundry detergent含洗衣液及洗衣粉等，来源为编辑增补待核验项。

answer.example_en: The washing is almost finished.
answer.example_zh: 衣服快洗好了。
answer.usage_note: washing在本场景指洗衣过程，英式日常常用。

rows.gloss: 一机次的洗衣量；一批衣物

answer.meaning_zh: 一机次的洗衣量；一批衣物
answer.example_en: I have another load to wash tonight.
answer.example_zh: 今晚我还有一机衣服要洗。
answer.usage_note: load指洗衣机一次洗的衣物量。

answer.example_en: Keep dirty laundry apart from clean clothes.
answer.example_zh: 把脏衣服和干净衣服分开放。
answer.usage_note: dirty laundry在这里取字面义：待洗衣物。

answer.example_en: The clean laundry is ready to be folded.
answer.example_zh: 洗好的衣服可以叠了。
answer.usage_note: clean laundry指已经洗净的衣服，未必已收纳。

answer.example_en: I use the laundromat when my washer breaks down.
answer.example_zh: 家里洗衣机坏了时，我去自助洗衣店。
answer.usage_note: laundromat为美式常用的自助洗衣店说法。

answer.example_en: Don't mix bleach with other cleaning products.
answer.example_zh: 不要将漂白剂与其他清洁剂混用。
answer.usage_note: 漂白剂尤其含氯产品不能与酸或氨类产品混合。

answer.example_en: I bought washing powder for the family laundry.
answer.example_zh: 我买了洗衣粉来洗全家的衣服。
answer.usage_note: washing powder为粉状洗衣剂，英式常见。

answer.example_en: This machine works with liquid detergent.
answer.example_zh: 这台洗衣机可使用洗衣液。
answer.usage_note: liquid detergent是液态洗涤剂，应按设备说明添加。

answer.example_en: I put the delicate socks in a mesh laundry bag.
answer.example_zh: 我把娇贵的袜子装进洗衣网袋。
answer.usage_note: mesh laundry bag能减少衣物摩擦和勾挂。

answer.example_en: There's lint on my black trousers.
answer.example_zh: 黑裤子上沾了毛絮。
answer.usage_note: lint是纤维毛絮，通常不可数。

answer.example_en: I clean the lint trap after each dryer cycle.
answer.example_zh: 每次烘干后我都会清理集绒滤网。
answer.usage_note: lint trap是烘干机绒毛过滤装置，需定期清洁。

answer.example_en: Read the washing instructions before using hot water.
answer.example_zh: 用热水洗衣前先读洗涤说明。
answer.usage_note: washing instructions指衣物适合的洗涤条件。

answer.example_en: I chose a gentle wash cycle for the blouse.
answer.example_zh: 我给那件女式衬衫选了轻柔洗涤程序。
answer.usage_note: wash cycle是洗衣机的洗涤程序。

answer.example_en: I added an extra rinse cycle for the towels.
answer.example_zh: 我给毛巾增加一次漂洗程序。
answer.usage_note: rinse cycle冲洗残留，与spin cycle脱水不同。

answer.example_en: I hang the towels on the drying rack.
answer.example_zh: 我把毛巾挂在晾衣架上。
collocations: hang clothes on a drying rack
answer.usage_note: drying rack是晾衣架，不是机器烘干机。

answer.example_en: We hung the sheets on the clothesline outside.
answer.example_zh: 我们把床单挂在室外晾衣绳上。
answer.usage_note: clothesline指用于晾晒衣物的绳索。

answer.example_en: I used a clothespin to secure the towel on the line.
answer.example_zh: 我用晾衣夹把毛巾固定在晾衣绳上。
answer.usage_note: clothespin是美式常用的晾衣夹说法；英式常说clothes peg。

answer.example_en: A clothes peg keeps the sheet from blowing away.
answer.example_zh: 一个晾衣夹防止床单被风吹走。
answer.usage_note: clothes peg是英式晾衣夹说法，与美式clothespin相近。

answer.example_en: Put the clean shirt on a hanger.
answer.example_zh: 把洗好的衬衫挂在衣架上。
collocations: hang a shirt on a hanger
answer.usage_note: hanger指衣架，区别于墙上的挂钩hook。

answer.example_en: The drying time is longer on humid days.
answer.example_zh: 潮湿天气衣服晾干所需时间更长。
answer.usage_note: drying time是晾干或烘干所需的时间。

answer.example_en: I air-dry my wool sweaters to avoid damaging them.
answer.example_zh: 我让羊毛衫自然晾干，以免损坏。
answer.usage_note: air-dry指不使用烘干机而自然风干；具体平铺还是悬挂以洗护标签为准。

answer.example_en: The label says not to tumble dry this dress.
answer.example_zh: 标签写着这条连衣裙不能滚筒烘干。
answer.usage_note: tumble dry指使用滚筒烘干机；与air-dry相对。

answer.example_en: I hand wash this scarf because the label requires it.
answer.example_zh: 标签要求手洗，所以这条围巾我会手洗。
answer.usage_note: hand wash强调用手洗而非机洗，亦可连写hand-wash。

answer.example_en: I'll dry-clean the suit instead of washing it at home.
answer.example_zh: 我会把西装送去干洗，而不是在家水洗。
answer.usage_note: dry-clean指专业干洗，应参考洗护标签。

answer.example_en: I wash the whites separately from dark clothes.
answer.example_zh: 我把白色衣物和深色衣物分开洗。
answer.usage_note: whites在洗衣语境指白色衣物，常用复数。

answer.example_en: I put the darks in a separate load.
answer.example_zh: 我把深色衣物分成单独一机来洗。
answer.usage_note: darks指深色衣物，是洗衣分类中的复数名词。

answer.example_en: Keep the colors separate from the whites.
answer.example_zh: 彩色衣物要与白色衣物分开。
answer.usage_note: colors在洗衣语境指彩色衣服；英式拼写colours。

answer.example_en: I put the delicates in a mesh laundry bag.
answer.example_zh: 我把精细衣物装进洗衣网袋。
answer.usage_note: delicates是需要轻柔护理的衣物，常用复数。

answer.example_en: This sweater is made of wool and needs gentle care.
answer.example_zh: 这件毛衣是羊毛的，需要轻柔护理。
answer.usage_note: wool在这里指羊毛材质，通常不可数。

answer.example_en: I prefer cotton towels because they absorb water well.
answer.example_zh: 我更喜欢棉毛巾，因为它们吸水性好。
answer.usage_note: cotton表示棉或棉质面料，在材质义上通常不可数。

answer.example_en: Linen shirts wrinkle easily after washing.
answer.example_zh: 亚麻衬衫洗后容易起皱。
answer.usage_note: linen指亚麻布料，常用作材质修饰语。

answer.example_en: Check the label before drying polyester clothes.
answer.example_zh: 烘干涤纶衣服前先看标签。
answer.usage_note: polyester是涤纶等聚酯纤维，护理要求应以标签为准。

answer.example_en: I washed the silk blouse by hand.
answer.example_zh: 我手洗了这件丝绸女式衬衫。
answer.usage_note: silk指丝绸或蚕丝材质，清洗前应确认洗护说明。

answer.example_en: I turn my jeans inside out before washing them.
answer.example_zh: 洗牛仔裤前，我把裤子翻到反面。
answer.usage_note: jeans在裤子义中常用复数，称一条可说a pair of jeans。

answer.example_en: I always lose one sock when doing laundry.
answer.example_zh: 每次洗衣服我总有一只袜子不见了。
answer.usage_note: socks是袜子的复数，单数sock。

answer.example_en: I wash underwear separately when needed.
answer.example_zh: 必要时我会把内衣裤单独洗。
answer.usage_note: underwear通常是不可数集合名词，不说an underwear。

answer.example_en: I change the bedsheets every weekend.
answer.example_zh: 我每个周末都换床单。
answer.usage_note: bedsheets是床单的复数，亦写作bed sheets。

answer.example_en: The pillowcases need washing too.
answer.example_zh: 枕套也该洗了。
answer.usage_note: pillowcase指枕套，不是枕芯。

answer.example_en: Please hang the towels up after washing them.
answer.example_zh: 洗完毛巾后请把它们挂起来。
answer.usage_note: towels为毛巾的复数，指可用于擦干的布巾。

answer.example_en: I wash the bath towels once they're ready for laundry.
answer.example_zh: 浴巾该洗的时候，我就把它们洗了。
answer.usage_note: bath towel是洗澡后擦身体的大毛巾。

answer.example_en: I keep the kitchen towels separate from bath towels.
answer.example_zh: 我把厨房布巾和浴巾分开放。
answer.usage_note: kitchen towels用于厨房擦拭，具体用途依材质与习惯。

answer.example_en: I wash my work uniform after every shift.
answer.example_zh: 每次下班后我都会洗工作制服。
answer.usage_note: uniform是制服，可数；不同岗位可能有专门洗护要求。

answer.example_en: My gym clothes need washing after that workout.
answer.example_zh: 锻炼完后，我的运动服该洗了。
answer.usage_note: gym clothes指锻炼时穿的运动服，常用复数。

answer.example_en: I keep my work clothes separate from weekend clothes.
answer.example_zh: 我把工作服和周末穿的衣服分开放。
answer.usage_note: work clothes指工作时穿的衣物，不一定是正式制服。

answer.example_en: Lay the sweater flat if the care label says so.
answer.example_zh: 如果洗护标签有要求，就把毛衣平铺晾干。
answer.usage_note: sweater指毛衣；英式还常说jumper。

answer.example_en: I iron the shirt after it has dried.
answer.example_zh: 衬衫干了后，我把它熨平。
answer.usage_note: shirt在这里指衬衫，通常可数。

answer.example_en: The sweat stain on the collar hasn't come out.
answer.example_zh: 衣领上的汗渍还没洗掉。
answer.usage_note: sweat stain是汗液造成的污渍。

answer.example_en: I noticed a grease stain on my apron.
answer.example_zh: 我发现围裙上有块油渍。
answer.usage_note: grease stain指油脂留下的污渍，通常需要合适的去油方法。

answer.example_en: There's a coffee stain on my white shirt.
answer.example_zh: 我的白衬衫上有块咖啡渍。
answer.usage_note: coffee stain指咖啡留下的污渍。

answer.example_en: The mud stain is still visible after washing.
answer.example_zh: 洗过以后泥渍还是看得见。
answer.usage_note: mud stain表示泥土造成的污渍。

answer.example_en: I noticed a small blood stain on the sleeve.
answer.example_zh: 我发现袖子上有一小块血渍。
answer.usage_note: blood stain表示血液留下的污渍，处理时应采取适当卫生防护。

answer.example_en: This fabric feels too delicate for a hot wash.
answer.example_zh: 这种面料太娇贵，不适合高温洗涤。
answer.usage_note: fabric指织物或面料，泛指材料而非特定一件衣物。

answer.example_en: The seam on these trousers is coming apart.
answer.example_zh: 这条裤子的接缝开始开线了。
answer.usage_note: seam是两块布料缝合处，不同于衣服下摆hem。

answer.example_en: Zip up the jacket before putting it in the wash if the label advises it.
answer.example_zh: 如果洗护说明建议，洗前先拉好外套拉链。
answer.usage_note: zipper是拉链，美式常用；英式也可说zip。

answer.example_en: One button came off in the wash.
answer.example_zh: 洗衣时掉了一颗纽扣。
answer.usage_note: button在此是衣服纽扣，也可作动词表示扣上。

answer.example_en: Check every pocket before starting the washer.
answer.example_zh: 开洗衣机前检查每个口袋。
answer.usage_note: pocket是衣服上的口袋，避免遗留纸巾或硬币。

answer.example_en: A coin was rattling around inside the washer drum.
answer.example_zh: 一枚硬币在洗衣机滚筒里叮当作响。
answer.usage_note: drum在此指洗衣机的滚筒，并非乐器鼓。

answer.example_en: Make sure the washer door is fully closed.
answer.example_zh: 确认洗衣机门已经关严。
answer.usage_note: washer door是洗衣机的门，不是洗衣房的门。

answer.example_en: The technician checked the water inlet for a blockage.
answer.example_zh: 技术人员检查了进水口是否堵塞。
answer.usage_note: water inlet指机器供水进入的位置。

answer.example_en: The drain hose behind the washer needs inspection.
answer.example_zh: 洗衣机后面的排水软管需要检查。
answer.usage_note: drain hose是排水软管，不是进水管。

rows.gloss: 把白色和彩色衣物分开

answer.meaning_zh: 把白色和彩色衣物分开
answer.example_en: Separate whites and colors before washing.
answer.example_zh: 洗衣前把白色和彩色衣物分开。
answer.usage_note: whites和colors在这里都指相应颜色的衣物。

answer.example_en: Check the pockets for coins and tissues.
answer.example_zh: 检查口袋里有没有硬币和纸巾。
answer.usage_note: check the pockets是检查，未必已经把物品取出。

answer.example_en: Empty your pockets before you put the trousers in the wash.
answer.example_zh: 把裤子放进洗衣机前，先把口袋掏空。
answer.usage_note: empty your pockets强调把口袋里的东西全部取出。

answer.example_en: Turn clothes inside out before washing when the label recommends it.
answer.example_zh: 标签建议时，洗衣前把衣服翻到反面。
answer.usage_note: inside out指衣服里外翻转，不是前后穿反。

answer.example_en: Zip up jackets before washing them to reduce snagging.
answer.example_zh: 洗夹克前先拉好拉链，减少勾挂。
answer.usage_note: zip up表示拉上拉链，洗涤准备须服从洗护说明。

answer.example_en: Fasten buttons before washing if the care instructions call for it.
answer.example_zh: 如果洗护说明要求，洗衣前扣好纽扣。
answer.usage_note: fasten buttons指扣好扣子，具体做法依衣物标签。

answer.example_en: Put clothes in the washer after checking the pockets.
answer.example_zh: 检查口袋后把衣服放进洗衣机。
answer.usage_note: washer在此是洗衣机的口语简称。

answer.example_en: Load the washing machine without packing it too tightly.
answer.example_zh: 往洗衣机装衣物，但不要塞太满。
answer.usage_note: load指往设备中装入物品。

answer.example_en: Don't overload the washer with heavy towels.
answer.example_zh: 别把太多厚毛巾塞进洗衣机。
answer.usage_note: overload表示超过适宜容量。

answer.example_en: Measure the detergent according to the label.
answer.example_zh: 按照标签说明量取洗涤剂。
answer.usage_note: measure指按指定用量量取。

answer.example_en: Add detergent to the correct compartment.
answer.example_zh: 将洗涤剂加入正确的投放格。
answer.usage_note: detergent是洗涤剂，不能与柔顺剂混淆。

answer.example_en: Pour in fabric softener if the instructions allow it.
answer.example_zh: 使用说明允许时才倒入柔顺剂。
answer.usage_note: fabric softener不替代洗涤剂。

answer.example_en: Choose a cycle that suits the fabric.
answer.example_zh: 选择适合面料的洗涤程序。
answer.usage_note: cycle在这里指洗衣程序。

answer.example_en: Set the temperature according to the care label.
answer.example_zh: 按洗护标签设定水温。
answer.usage_note: temperature在此指洗衣水温。

answer.example_en: Start the wash after loading the machine.
answer.example_zh: 装好衣物后启动洗衣。
answer.usage_note: start the wash表示启动洗涤流程。

answer.example_en: Pause the cycle if you need to check something.
answer.example_zh: 需要检查时先暂停洗涤程序。
answer.usage_note: pause表示暂停而非取消。

answer.example_en: Run an extra rinse if recommended.
answer.example_zh: 如果说明建议，就额外漂洗一次。
answer.usage_note: extra rinse是增加漂洗阶段。

answer.example_en: Rinse out detergent before drying the clothes.
answer.example_zh: 晾衣前把洗涤剂漂洗干净。
answer.usage_note: rinse out是冲走残留物。

answer.example_en: Spin the clothes to remove excess water.
answer.example_zh: 给衣服脱水甩掉多余水分。
answer.usage_note: spin在此指机器旋转脱水。

answer.example_en: Take out the laundry when the cycle finishes.
answer.example_zh: 程序结束后取出衣物。
collocations: take laundry out of the washer
answer.usage_note: take out表示从机器中取出。

answer.example_en: Transfer clothes to the dryer if the label allows it.
answer.example_zh: 标签允许时将衣物转移至烘干机。
answer.usage_note: transfer是从一处转移至另一处。

answer.example_en: Load the dryer loosely to allow airflow.
answer.example_zh: 松散地装入烘干机以利空气流通。
answer.usage_note: load the dryer意为将衣物装入烘干设备。

answer.example_en: Clean the lint trap before starting the dryer.
answer.example_zh: 启动烘干机前清理绒毛滤网。
answer.usage_note: lint trap是烘干机绒毛过滤网。

rows.gloss: 把洗好的衣服挂出去晾

answer.meaning_zh: 把洗好的衣服挂出去晾
answer.example_en: I hang out the washing when the weather is dry.
answer.example_zh: 天气干燥时我把衣服挂出去晾。
answer.usage_note: hang out在此指将衣物挂出晾晒。

answer.example_en: Hang clothes on a line with space between them.
answer.example_zh: 把衣物挂在晾衣绳上并留些间距。
answer.usage_note: line在此是晾衣绳。

rows.gloss: 用夹子把衣物固定在晾衣绳上

answer.meaning_zh: 用夹子把衣物固定在晾衣绳上
answer.example_en: Peg clothes to the line so the wind can't blow them away.
answer.example_zh: 用晾衣夹把衣物固定在绳上防风吹。
answer.usage_note: peg作动词表示用夹子固定，偏英式。

answer.example_en: Hang up a shirt on a hanger after washing it.
answer.example_zh: 洗好衬衫后把它挂到衣架上。
collocations: hang a shirt on a hanger
answer.usage_note: hang up表示挂起来。

answer.example_en: Lay the sweater flat to dry.
answer.example_zh: 把毛衣平铺晾干。
collocations: lay a sweater flat to dry
answer.usage_note: lay flat to dry指平铺以避免变形。

answer.example_en: Dry the colorful shirts in the shade.
answer.example_zh: 将彩色衬衫放在阴凉处晾干。
answer.usage_note: shade是没有阳光直射的阴凉处。

answer.example_en: Bring the washing in before it rains.
answer.example_zh: 下雨前把晾着的衣服收进来。
answer.usage_note: bring in是从外面收回室内。

answer.example_en: Take clothes off the line once they are dry.
answer.example_zh: 衣服晾干后从绳上取下来。
answer.usage_note: off the line强调从绳上取下。

answer.example_en: Pair up socks before storing them.
answer.example_zh: 收纳前把袜子配成对。
answer.usage_note: pair up表示将匹配的两只配对。

answer.example_en: Put clothes away after folding them.
answer.example_zh: 叠好后把衣服放回衣柜。
answer.usage_note: put away表示归位收纳。

answer.example_en: Iron a shirt at the temperature shown on its label.
answer.example_zh: 按标签标示温度熨衬衫。
answer.usage_note: iron在此作动词熨烫。

answer.example_en: Steam a garment to smooth minor wrinkles.
answer.example_zh: 用蒸汽熨烫衣物，抚平轻微褶皱。
answer.usage_note: steam作动词是用蒸汽处理衣物。

answer.example_en: Shake out wrinkles before hanging the shirt.
answer.example_zh: 挂衬衫前抖一抖，减少褶皱。
answer.usage_note: shake out指通过抖动舒展褶皱。

answer.example_en: Pre-treat a stain before washing the garment.
answer.example_zh: 洗衣前先预处理污渍。
answer.usage_note: pre-treat指正式洗涤前处理。

answer.example_en: Soak the clothes only as long as the label permits.
answer.example_zh: 浸泡衣物不要超过洗护标签允许的时间。
answer.usage_note: soak表示浸在液体中。

answer.example_en: Gently scrub the stain with a suitable brush.
answer.example_zh: 用适当的刷子轻轻搓洗污渍。
answer.usage_note: scrub强调摩擦清洁。

answer.example_en: I wash by hand when the label requires it.
answer.example_zh: 标签有要求时我会手洗。
answer.usage_note: by hand与机洗相对。

answer.example_en: Don't wring out clothes that may lose their shape.
answer.example_zh: 容易变形的衣服不要拧干。
answer.usage_note: wring out指扭拧排水。

answer.example_en: Squeeze out water gently without twisting the sweater.
answer.example_zh: 轻轻挤出毛衣里的水，别扭拧。
answer.usage_note: squeeze是挤压，不一定需要扭转。

answer.example_en: The clothes are clean and ready to dry.
answer.example_zh: 衣服洗干净了，可以晾了。
answer.usage_note: clean在此是形容词干净的。

answer.example_en: Put the dirty towels in the hamper.
answer.example_zh: 把脏毛巾放进脏衣篓。
answer.usage_note: dirty表示有污物。

answer.example_en: The towels smell fresh after washing.
answer.example_zh: 毛巾洗完后闻起来很清新。
answer.usage_note: fresh在此指洗后清新。

answer.example_en: The shirt is damp, so leave it hanging.
answer.example_zh: 衬衫还有些潮，继续挂着吧。
answer.usage_note: damp比soaking wet程度轻。

answer.example_en: These socks are still wet.
answer.example_zh: 这些袜子还湿着。
answer.usage_note: wet表示有水分。

answer.example_en: The jacket was soaking wet after the rain.
answer.example_zh: 淋雨后夹克湿透了。
answer.usage_note: soaking wet是非常湿的强调表达。

answer.example_en: The towels were bone-dry after a day in the sun.
answer.example_zh: 毛巾晒了一天后完全干透了。
answer.usage_note: bone-dry表示非常干燥。

answer.example_en: The jeans are still damp around the pockets.
answer.example_zh: 牛仔裤口袋附近仍有些潮。
answer.usage_note: still damp说明尚未完全干燥。

answer.example_en: The shirt is wrinkled from being left in the dryer.
answer.example_zh: 衬衫放在烘干机里太久，皱了。
answer.usage_note: wrinkled指多处起皱。

answer.example_en: These trousers are creased from folding.
answer.example_zh: 这条裤子折叠后有折痕。
answer.usage_note: creased侧重折痕线条。

answer.example_en: The sweater came out shrunken after a hot wash.
answer.example_zh: 毛衣热水洗完后缩水了。
answer.usage_note: shrunken表示尺寸缩小。

answer.example_en: The neckline is stretched out from hanging.
answer.example_zh: 领口悬挂后被拉松变形了。
answer.usage_note: stretched out指拉长松弛。

answer.example_en: My faded jeans used to be much darker.
answer.example_zh: 我的牛仔裤褪色了，以前颜色深得多。
answer.usage_note: faded指褪色。

answer.example_en: The label says this cotton is colorfast.
answer.example_zh: 标签说这种棉料不易掉色。
answer.usage_note: colorfast指染料不易在洗涤中褪色或转移。

rows.gloss: 衣物染料串色；掉色染到其他衣物

answer.meaning_zh: 衣物染料串色；掉色染到其他衣物
answer.example_en: The red socks caused color bleeding onto my white shirt.
answer.example_zh: 红袜子掉色，把我的白衬衫染上了颜色。
answer.usage_note: color bleeding指染料在洗涤时转移到其他衣物，区别于单纯褪色。

answer.example_en: This stained blouse needs treatment before washing.
answer.example_zh: 这件有污渍的女式衬衫需要先处理再洗。
answer.usage_note: stained形容带有污渍的状态，stain也可作名词。

answer.example_en: The towels smell musty after sitting damp overnight.
answer.example_zh: 毛巾湿着放了一夜，闻起来有股霉闷味。
answer.usage_note: musty指久湿或不通风产生的霉闷味，不表示确定检测到霉菌。

answer.example_en: The towels came out fluffy after drying.
answer.example_zh: 毛巾烘干后变得蓬松。
answer.usage_note: fluffy强调松软、蓬松，常用于毛巾、毯子等。

answer.example_en: The shirts feel stiff after drying on the line.
answer.example_zh: 衬衫晾干后摸起来硬邦邦的。
answer.usage_note: stiff在此是布料不柔软、发硬，不是人态度僵硬。

answer.example_en: The blanket feels soft after washing.
answer.example_zh: 毯子洗完后摸起来很柔软。
answer.usage_note: soft形容触感柔软，和stiff相对。

answer.example_en: This jacket is machine-washable according to its label.
answer.example_zh: 标签显示这件夹克可以机洗。
answer.usage_note: machine-washable表示可机洗，仍需遵守温度及程序规定。

answer.example_en: The label says this sweater is hand-wash only.
answer.example_zh: 标签注明这件毛衣只能手洗。
answer.usage_note: hand-wash only是洗护限制，不能按普通机洗程序处理。

answer.example_en: This suit is dry-clean only, so I'll take it to the cleaners.
answer.example_zh: 这套西装只能干洗，我会送去干洗店。
answer.usage_note: dry-clean only表示只能干洗，不宜自行水洗。

answer.example_en: I set the dryer to low heat for these shirts.
answer.example_zh: 我给这些衬衫选择了低温烘干。
answer.usage_note: low heat指较低的烘干温度，须以衣物标签为准。

answer.example_en: High heat can damage some delicate fabrics.
answer.example_zh: 高温可能损坏某些娇贵面料。
answer.usage_note: high heat是较高温度档位，不适合所有材质。

answer.example_en: The care label recommends a cold wash.
answer.example_zh: 洗护标签建议冷水洗。
answer.usage_note: cold wash指用冷水洗涤，具体温度由设备或标签定义。

answer.example_en: I chose a warm wash for the cotton towels.
answer.example_zh: 我为这些棉毛巾选择了温水洗涤。
answer.usage_note: warm wash是温水档位，适用与否取决于标签。

answer.example_en: Don't use a hot wash on this delicate sweater.
answer.example_zh: 这件娇贵的毛衣不要用热水洗。
answer.usage_note: hot wash指较高水温洗涤，有些面料可能缩水。

answer.example_en: I use a quick wash for a small load of lightly worn clothes.
answer.example_zh: 少量不太脏的衣服我用快速洗涤。
answer.usage_note: quick wash是较短洗涤程序，未必适合重污衣物。

answer.example_en: Select the gentle cycle for delicate fabrics.
answer.example_zh: 精细面料要选择轻柔洗涤程序。
answer.usage_note: gentle cycle通常动作较温和，应根据洗护标签选择。

answer.example_en: I used the heavy-duty cycle for heavily soiled towels.
answer.example_zh: 很脏的毛巾我用了强力洗涤程序。
answer.usage_note: heavy-duty cycle用于较耐洗且较脏的衣物，不适合娇贵面料。

answer.example_en: I lowered the spin speed for the delicate blouse.
answer.example_zh: 我为这件娇贵衬衫调低了脱水转速。
answer.usage_note: spin speed指甩干时滚筒旋转速度，通常与皱褶及含水量有关。

answer.example_en: The eco setting uses a different wash program to save energy.
answer.example_zh: 节能档使用另一套洗涤程序以节省能源。
answer.usage_note: eco setting指设备节能模式，运行时长和用水量因机器而异。

answer.example_en: There's a stubborn stain on the cuff that won't wash out.
answer.example_zh: 袖口有块顽固污渍，怎么洗也洗不掉。
answer.usage_note: stubborn在此指难以去除，并非人的固执。

rows.gloss: 已经渗入织物的旧污渍

answer.meaning_zh: 已经渗入织物的旧污渍
answer.example_en: This old set-in stain may be difficult to remove.
answer.example_zh: 这块渗进面料的旧污渍可能很难去除。
answer.usage_note: set-in stain通常指已附着较久、深入纤维的污渍。

answer.example_en: Wool sweaters may shrink in the wash if washed incorrectly.
answer.example_zh: 羊毛衫洗涤不当可能缩水。
answer.usage_note: shrink in the wash指洗后尺寸缩小。

rows.gloss: 漂白剂造成的脱色痕迹

answer.meaning_zh: 漂白剂造成的脱色痕迹
answer.example_en: The dark shirt has a bleach stain near the collar.
answer.example_zh: 深色衬衫领口附近有一块漂白剂造成的脱色痕。
answer.usage_note: bleach stain常是漂白剂导致颜色被去除的痕迹，不一定能洗掉。

answer.example_en: The washing machine has a musty smell when it's closed up.
answer.example_zh: 洗衣机一直关着时有股霉闷味。
collocations: get rid of a musty smell
answer.usage_note: musty smell描述霉闷气味，不等于确定存在霉菌。

answer.example_en: I noticed mildew on the damp towel.
answer.example_zh: 我发现潮湿毛巾上出现了霉斑。
answer.usage_note: mildew常用于描述潮湿织物表面的霉斑。

answer.example_en: Lint buildup around the dryer filter needs attention.
answer.example_zh: 烘干机滤网周围的毛絮堆积需要清理。
answer.usage_note: lint buildup指毛絮逐渐积聚，可能影响烘干效率和安全。

answer.example_en: A clogged filter can make the dryer work poorly.
answer.example_zh: 过滤网堵塞会导致烘干机工作效果变差。
answer.usage_note: clogged指被积聚物堵住，不等于过滤网破损。

answer.example_en: The washer isn't draining properly because of a drainage problem.
answer.example_zh: 洗衣机排水出了故障，水排不干净。
answer.usage_note: drainage指排水，problem可以是堵塞或其他故障。

answer.example_en: We noticed a washer leak near the back of the machine.
answer.example_zh: 我们发现洗衣机背后附近漏水。
answer.usage_note: washer leak指洗衣机漏水；涉及电源和水时应停止使用并请专业人员检查。

rows.gloss: 洗衣机衣物分布不平衡

answer.meaning_zh: 洗衣机衣物分布不平衡
answer.example_en: An unbalanced load made the washing machine shake.
answer.example_zh: 衣物分布不平衡导致洗衣机晃动。
answer.usage_note: unbalanced load指滚筒内衣物重量分布不均。

answer.example_en: The washer reported a spin failure at the end of the cycle.
answer.example_zh: 洗涤结束时洗衣机提示脱水故障。
answer.usage_note: spin failure指设备无法正常甩干，具体原因需检查。

answer.example_en: The broken zipper scratched the inside of the drum.
answer.example_zh: 坏掉的拉链划到了滚筒内壁。
answer.usage_note: broken zipper指无法正常使用或损坏的拉链。

answer.example_en: I found a loose button on my work shirt.
answer.example_zh: 我发现工作衬衫有一颗纽扣松了。
answer.usage_note: loose button表示纽扣未固定牢靠，还不一定掉落。

answer.example_en: Fabric pilling is visible on the sleeves of this sweater.
answer.example_zh: 这件毛衣袖子上明显起球了。
answer.usage_note: fabric pilling指纤维摩擦后形成小毛球。

answer.example_en: Static cling makes the socks stick to the shirts.
answer.example_zh: 静电粘连让袜子贴在衬衫上。
answer.usage_note: static cling指衣物因静电而相互吸附。

answer.example_en: I use a lint roller to remove lint from black trousers.
answer.example_zh: 我用黏毛滚筒去除黑裤子上的毛絮。
answer.usage_note: lint是细小纤维毛絮，通常不可数。

answer.example_en: I couldn't get the stain out of the white T-shirt.
answer.example_zh: 我没能把白T恤上的污渍洗掉。
collocations: get a stain out of fabric
answer.usage_note: get a stain out是口语说法，表示成功去除污渍。

answer.example_en: I spot-clean the collar instead of washing the whole coat.
answer.example_zh: 我只局部清洁领口，而不是洗整件外套。
answer.usage_note: spot-clean指只处理有污渍的小面积区域。

answer.example_en: I had to re-wash clothes that were left damp overnight.
answer.example_zh: 衣服潮湿地放了一夜，我只好重新洗一遍。
answer.usage_note: re-wash强调再次洗涤；也常写作rewash。

answer.example_en: The manual recommends running the washer empty for its cleaning cycle.
answer.example_zh: 说明书建议在清洁程序中让洗衣机空机运行。
answer.usage_note: run the washer empty指机内不放衣物运行，需遵守设备说明。

answer.example_en: I clean the drum using the machine's cleaning program.
answer.example_zh: 我用洗衣机的清洁程序清洁滚筒。
answer.usage_note: drum在这里是洗衣机滚筒，不是鼓。

answer.example_en: I leave the washer door open after laundry when it's safe to do so.
answer.example_zh: 洗衣结束后，在安全的情况下我会开着洗衣机门通风。
answer.usage_note: leave open表示保持打开状态；有儿童或宠物时须注意安全。

answer.example_en: Avoid overloading the machine so the laundry can move freely.
answer.example_zh: 避免装得过满，让衣物能够自由翻动。
answer.usage_note: overloading表示超量装载，不是正常填满。

answer.example_en: Check the drain if water remains in the washer.
answer.example_zh: 如果洗衣机里还积着水，就检查排水处。
answer.usage_note: check the drain是检查排水是否畅通，勿在通电状态拆机。

answer.example_en: I use a color catcher when washing mixed-color items as directed.
answer.example_zh: 按产品说明混洗不同颜色衣物时，我会用吸色片。
answer.usage_note: color catcher是吸附游离染料的洗衣用品，不能保证完全防止串色。

answer.example_en: Test for colorfastness on a hidden section of the fabric.
answer.example_zh: 在面料不显眼处测试是否容易掉色。
answer.usage_note: colorfastness指染料在洗涤等条件下保持颜色的能力。

answer.example_en: Always follow the care instructions before washing delicate items.
answer.example_zh: 洗娇贵衣物前一定要遵循洗护说明。
answer.usage_note: care instructions通常写在洗护标签上。

answer.example_en: Keep this silk blouse away from direct sunlight while drying.
answer.example_zh: 晾干这件真丝衬衫时要避开阳光直射。
answer.usage_note: direct sunlight指直接照射的阳光，不同于明亮通风处。

answer.example_en: Remove clothes promptly once the washing cycle ends.
answer.example_zh: 洗衣程序结束后及时取出衣服。
answer.usage_note: promptly强调不要长时间把湿衣物留在机器里。

answer.example_en: Separate damp clothes so they can dry properly.
answer.example_zh: 把潮湿衣物分开放，让它们能充分晾干。
answer.usage_note: damp是微湿，衣物堆放可能不易晾干。

rows.gloss: 把有异味的一机衣物重新洗

answer.meaning_zh: 把有异味的一机衣物重新洗
answer.example_en: Rewash a smelly load rather than putting it straight in the dryer.
answer.example_zh: 一机衣服有异味时重新洗，不要直接放进烘干机。
answer.usage_note: rewash表示重洗；异味衣物应先查找原因。

answer.example_en: The red towel caused color bleed in the wash.
answer.example_zh: 红毛巾洗涤时掉色，导致衣物串色。
answer.usage_note: color bleed为衣物染料转移或掉色的表达；属待独立审核补缺候选。

answer.example_en: Take the laundry out as soon as the cycle finishes.
answer.example_zh: 洗衣程序结束就把衣物取出来。
collocations: take laundry out of the washer
answer.usage_note: take out表示从洗衣机中取出；此源项是待独立审核增补候选。
